instruction: docs/v07/m2/M2_instruction_timing_rehearsal.md §12: 出现异常导致无法算完，或类别超出三类：停下汇报
cause: The geometry_* glob includes the geometry_history.json file; the replay script incorrectly treats it as a round directory.
proposed_fix: Enumerate only directories matching geometry_XX before reading skeleton.json, then rerun the offline replay without any simulation or source-data changes.
resolution: User clarified that errors in execution-owned tool scripts should be repaired directly. Filter now accepts only geometry_[0-9][0-9] directories. Q-B was rerun from scratch and passed: 20 complete rounds, three input_missing rounds, zero simulations. See qb_summary.json and qb_offline_replay.csv for the superseding full result.
